description: This file defines a React component named 'Column' which represents a Kanban column in a task management interface. It handles displaying the column title, inline editing of the title, rendering associated cards via the 'CardList' component, and modal interactions for deleting and archiving the column.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new title for the column, ensuring it is not empty or unchanged.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Starts inline editing mode for editing the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new title for the column after validation, handling API update call and user feedback.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles key events in the title input field, triggering save on Enter and cancel on Escape.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Triggers modal display for column deletion confirmation.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs the actual deletion of the column after user confirms in modal, with success/error toast feedback.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.name: Column
ctags.pattern: /^function Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
